hooks.text: 输入敌人头顶单词完成击杀，不同词敌会逼近、射弹或蓄力开火
hooks.excerpt: Not Your Ordinary Typing Test Type the word above an enemy to finish them off. Challenge your focus and speed as bigger waves and wicked words try to slow you down and take you out. These wily words also have a few tricks up their sleeves. Deterministic drones will simply edge closer towards you, but egregious enemies like Swarmers will fire their little bullets at you, while Shooters charge up to unleash hell on you.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 可用Oscillator和Sentry覆盖区域，也能把主武器极限进化成字母刺客
hooks.excerpt: Kit Out; Don’t Keysmash Furiously fast fingers will never be enough! Upgrade your arsenal with unlockable weapons and loot that can help you make quick work of each wave of words. Each build is uniquely yours. Set up your Oscillator and Sentry to take care of a large swathe of territory while you pick off the stragglers, or minmax your main weapon to evolve into an alphabet assassinator? The choice is yours!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每项Trial终点由Boss把守，通关后解锁让敌人更强的Omen挑战
hooks.excerpt: (Hot)Swap your Strategies in Formidable Boss Fights There are multiple trials for you to overcome, and a boss guarding the end of each trial. Defeating the trials unlock challenging Omens that make your enemies even more formidable.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
